name: Horusath Blast applies its debuff to every enemy in front (#4052)
contract: Issue #4052: the tooltip promises the debuff on all enemies in front within 8 yards, but only the single hit target received it because OnSpellHitResult called Cast(player, target, 572050) once for 500154.

The handler now also casts 572050 on every other valid enemy within 8 yards in the caster's front arc. Three hostile fixtures stand at 3, 5 and 7 yards in front; after one cast all three must carry 572050, while the primary target still takes the Holy damage.

steps.label: Let login and class synchronisation settle
The hit target keeps the debuff
The second frontal enemy is debuffed too
The third frontal enemy is debuffed too
